g.title: title
g.text: Useful state > observed gaps > enforceable contracts > measured decisions
Teal: observed or built Gold: proposed Navy: context or calculations

g.title: act1
g.text: 1 An agent needs alternatives from a reached state.
Useful captured state must remain valid for each continuation.
A fork must also compete on cost with rebuilding that state.
The factory has not demonstrated a valuable live-state workload.

g.title: note
g.text: Arrows connect the seminar argument and design; they do not imply empirical causal proof.
Case-study runs did not fork. Three-Body Atlas is a preliminary example of evidence admission, not a fork result.
Continue on the two reading pages for mechanisms, precise observations, decision rules, and linked sources.

g.title: act2
g.text: 2 Preserve the state a continuation actually needs.
Files and dependencies: compare worktrees and a warm cache.
Processes or RAM: prove what checkpoint and restore preserve.
Changed code may require reload or restart before validation.

g.title: parent
g.text: Not demonstrated in the factory run.

g.title: act3
g.text: 3 The factory exposed coverage and preservation gaps.
Installer task: add two missing redirect domains.
A failed dispatch test led to an out-of-plan source repair.
Same-owner adoption lacked a direct deterministic test.
Separate work order: delivery refused; teardown lost the patch.

g.title: act4
g.text: 4 Give branches state, evidence, and authority contracts.
STATE: preserve, refresh, or restart as the task requires.
EVIDENCE: exact artifact, outcome, observations, and lineage.
AUTHORITY: host authenticates and authorizes each child.
Publication binds to the artifact and current authority.

g.title: act5
g.text: 5 The reducer rejects duplicates and retains lineage.
Pool only measurements of one common target quantity.
Repeated evidence IDs stop merge; lineage travels with results.
Patch selection and composition require separate validation.
Distinct IDs alone do not calibrate dependence.

g.title: verify
g.text: Choose a candidate; do not pool patches.
Reload or restart changed code if needed.
Verify the exact artifact and its

g.title: act6
g.text: 6 Experiments must justify the runtime choices.
H1: choose restore or a warm-template backend by cost.
H2: assess environmental co-failure and ancestry modeling.
Targeted test: resolve the missing behavioral obligation.
Repair resamples: describe repeatability of edits.

g.title: publish
g.text: PROPOSED AUTHORITY FLOW; DIGEST GATE BUILT

g.title: tests
g.text: H1: restore vs warm cached template

g.title: precision
g.text: it does not determine their strength.
